title.en: All clear — the smoke alert has ended
title.zh-Hant: 警報解除 — 煙霧警報結束

instruction.en: No further action is needed. Normal monitoring has resumed.
instruction.zh-Hant: 毋須採取進一步行動。監察已回復正常。

body.en: Estate staff are attending 12/F. Fire Services have been called as a precaution.
body.zh-Hant: 屋苑職員正前往12樓。已預防性通知消防處。

body.en: Fire Services found burnt food, not a fire. The alert is stood down and monitoring has resumed.
body.zh-Hant: 消防處證實為食物燒焦而非火警。警報解除，監察已回復正常。

disclaimer.en: This alert supplements the building fire alarm and statutory emergency procedures. It does not replace them, and it may be delayed or unavailable.
disclaimer.zh-Hant: 此警報為輔助性質，不能取代大廈火警系統及法定緊急程序，並可能延遲或無法提供。
